jobs.description:
Our client is an international organisation operating within a highly regulated and innovative industry. From its European hub in Brussels, the company supports customers across multiple European markets, delivering high-quality solutions and services while maintaining a strong focus on customer satisfaction, collaboration, and operational excellence.

Jobomschrijving

Invoicing & Financial Administration

• Prepare, verify, and process invoices for customer service activities across European markets.
• Review work orders, service reports, and supporting documentation prior to invoicing.
• Follow up on missing, incomplete, or inaccurate information.
• Collaborate closely with Finance to ensure accurate and timely billing.
Administrative Support

• Maintain and update administrative records and documentation.
• Ensure data accuracy within ERP and CRM systems.
• Provide administrative support to Customer Experience and Customer Care teams.
• Prepare, monitor, and manage a variety of operational documents and reports.
Supply Chain & Warehouse Support

• Provide administrative back-up for spare parts order processing.
• Support logistics and warehouse administration activities.
• Assist with shipment documentation and transportation-related paperwork.
• Act as a flexible support resource during peak periods or colleague absences.
International Coordination

• Communicate regularly with customers and colleagues across Europe.
• Support cross-functional collaboration between various departments and countries.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in an administrative, customer service, or commercial support role.
• Experience with invoicing or billing processes is a strong advantage.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Customer-oriented mindset and effective communication skills.
• Ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
• Flexible, proactive, and supportive team player.
• Capable of working independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
• Experience with ERP systems is an advantage; SAP knowledge is considered a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and French
• Knowledge of German is highly desirable
• Good level of English

Van Heyghen Staal is a modern steel service center located in Evergem, in the Ghent canal zone near the Port of Ghent. Founded in 1981, the company processes around 250,000 tons of steel plates per year on its cut-to-length and slitting lines, and supplies hot-rolled sheets, plates and slit coils to clients across Europe in a wide range of sectors. Its strong position in the European market is built on quality, innovation, service and just-in-time delivery. To support its automated production lines and upcoming projects, Van Heyghen Staal is looking for a Junior Industrial Engineer in Electromechanics.

Jobomschrijving

Job descriptionAs a Junior Industrial Engineer in Electromechanics, you will start with an extensive learning program in which you will get to know our activities and automated lines in detail. You will build expertise in technology, processes and concepts. After this onboarding period, you can grow within Maintenance, Operations or Projects, depending on your interests and talents.

• Managing spare parts and helping plan preventive and corrective maintenance.
• Analyzing breakdowns and developing sustainable solutions.
• Actively contributing to investment and innovation projects.
• Coaching and supporting the technical team so that production runs continuously and optimally.
• Taking part in a rotation to coordinate Saturday maintenance approximately every 6 weeks.
• Contributing to digitalization and automation projects.
• Supporting energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives.
• Monitoring and improving technical safety procedures.
• Involvement in a production line renewal project.

Profile

• Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Electromechanics.
• Preferably at least 3 years of experience, but motivated starters are also welcome (junior profile with some experience).
• Broad technical interest: mechanics, pneumatics, electronics, hydraulics and electricity.
• Hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented.
• Knowledge of automation, drive technology and technical drawing is a plus.
• Good command of English is essential; additional languages

?? Where’s all this happening?

At a company based at Arcelor Mittal (Ghent/Zelzate) – not just any place!They’re experts in packing machines, installations, steel, and more. If it needs wrapping, these folks do it better than bubble wrap.

Jobomschrijving

Looking for a job where your muscles will finally have something to do – and steel will tremble at the sight of you? We’ve got just the thing for you!

Our client is on the hunt for a new team member – a packer with personality, humor, and the guts to face the mighty steel rolls in a three-shift battle. If you're not afraid of a challenge, love to stay active, and see “team” as more than just a word – then you’re exactly who they’re looking for!

Ready to roll?

Click, apply, and pack your future with us – strong, stable, and well-paid.

Who are we looking for?

Maybe you, if:

• You’re in shape – no need to be The Rock, but lifting steel rolls does require more than just clicking a mouse ??,
• Shifts? Three? You’re in – no whining, no problem,
• You take safety seriously (a forklift is not a race car ?),
• Small talk is your superpower – you feel like a fish in water speaking Dutch or English.

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

We are looking for experienced pharmaceutical professionals who want to actively contribute to the future of medicine. This is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to further develop your expertise and grow your career in a dynamic, mission-driven environment focused on patient impact.

If you already have experience in cleanroom operations, pharmaceutical manufacturing or chemical processes, or if you combine a relevant educational background with hands-on experience, we would very much like to hear from you.

Your role and responsibilities;

• Actively participate in aseptic and manual pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
• Work in cleanroom and laboratory environments in accordance with GMP standards.
• Perform production activities in controlled environments (Grade A/B/C/D), including spiking, media exchanges, cell culture activities and freezing of therapeutic products.
• Execute thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials and equipment.
• Support transitions between production zones, ensuring compliance and continuity.

This role is suited for you if you:

• Have relevant pharmaceutical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences.
• Have experience in a cleanroom, pharmaceutical, or chemical environment.
• Enjoy working in a structured environment and following procedures.
• Communicate fluently in English.
• Live near Zwijnaarde and can commute independently to the site.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology enterprise bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this initiative, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are seeking motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.

What You’ll Do

• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients.
Good to KnowYou’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:

• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Team Lead, you will be responsible for the daily production of personalized cell therapies for both clinical and commercial use in a sterile cGMP environment. You will coordinate the different units within the CAR-T process and ensure that all activities are carried out safely and in full compliance with cGMP requirements — while steering and organizing the operations from your office-based workspace, keeping a strong overview of the production flow and acting as the central point of coordination for the team. If you don't have prior leadership experience yet, that is also okay. 

What you can expect: 

• Coordinate and supervise operational units within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
• Act as the first point of contact for production issues and collaborate closely with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
• Serve as a domain expert for Quality and Operations in cGMP environments and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
• Manage all quality-related production aspects, including procedures, work instructions, logbooks, transfer forms, batch record review and release, and overall cGMP compliance.
• Coordinate quality system activities such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
• Ensure proper training of team members and promote a culture of continuous learning.
• Drive operational excellence by initiating improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall quality.

Who we are looking for: 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma. 
• Experience in people management, or with relatable coordinating activities such as training, coaching, ... .
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations; familiarity with Microsoft Office is required, and experience with MES/EBR is a plus.
• Strong communication and organizational skills. You don’t need formal leadership experience, but you do show natural leadership qualities.
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with strong attention to detail.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily production process of personalized cell therapy, both for clinical and commercial purposes. You will lead various units within the CAR-T process and ensure safe and compliant production activities in accordance with cGMP requirements — all while coordinating and overseeing operations from your dedicated office workspace, maintaining a clear overview of the production floor and ensuring smooth cross-team collaboration.

Tasks:

• Lead and supervise operational units within the CAR-T production process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
• Act as the primary point of contact for production-related topics, ensuring smooth coordination with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
• Provide hands-on leadership on the shop floor, supporting teams in daily operations, troubleshooting, and decision-making in cGMP environments.
• Serve as a subject matter expert for Quality and Operations and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
• Oversee production quality activities, including documentation management (procedures, work instructions, logs, transfer forms), batch record review and release, and compliance with cGMP standards.
• Coordinate quality system processes such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
• Guide and support team development through structured training and operational coaching.
• Drive operational excellence by leading process improvements focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and quality enhancement.

Who we are looking for: 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a production environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma.
• Strong experience in management, for example as a production lead, supervisor, or similar leadership role.
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations, cleanroom operations, and familiarity with Microsoft Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus.
• Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills with an empathetic and people-oriented management style.
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with a strong attention to detail.
• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. The company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

Currently in a phase of significant growth, they are looking for motivated and dedicated team members to join their mission.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Are you a (recent) graduate with a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences? Are you ready to put your knowledge and skills into practice in a setting where innovation meets purpose?

We’re looking for ambitious, detail-oriented professionals to help shape the future of medicine. At our leading biotech company, you won’t just find a job you’ll begin a meaningful, long-term career in advanced biomanufacturing.

Your journey starts with comprehensive training, where you’ll learn the fundamentals of aseptic (germ-free) techniques and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), the key standards that guide our industry. You’ll quickly gain confidence with the tools, procedures, and mindset that define high-quality biotech production.

After onboarding, you’ll join our dynamic Operations team, working hands-on with cutting-edge technologies and sterile processes. Together with your colleagues, you’ll perform precise manual and aseptic production steps, always following clear protocols to guarantee patient safety and product quality.

What your day-to-day will look like:

• Contributing to aseptic and manual production processes
• Working in a cleanroom laboratory environment
• Performing production steps in controlled areas (grade A/B/C/D), such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products
• Managing equipment, including inspections and maintenance
• Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials
• Supporting transitions between production zones
• Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

• You’re eager to apply your scientific background and contribute to something meaningful, making a real difference in the lives of patients.
• You’re energized by dynamic environments and excited to keep learning and growing within advanced biomanufacturing.
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences, and you’re ready to take the next step from the classroom to cutting-edge industry.
• You value structure and precision, and you feel comfortable working in a sterile (aseptic) setting, wearing the proper cleanroom gear.
• High-tech equipment and innovative processes spark your curiosity, you want to be part of what’s next.
• You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken.
• You’re a real team player with a strong eye for detail, and you understand the importance of following procedures carefully.
• You’re flexible and open to working in shifts.
• You’re excited about a 4-days-on, 4-days-off schedule that supports both focus and work-life balance.

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent) to support the Black Friday sale from 16 November until 4 December. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year, you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 5u10 

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the teams. Your tasks will include:

• Maintenance and monitoring of electrical systems, such as switchboards, electrical installations, and emergency repairs;
• Supervision of gas installations, ensuring safety and proper functioning of these systems;
• Maintenance of HVAC systems (Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning), ensuring adequate temperature and air quality in buildings;
• Diagnostics and repair of heating systems.

Profile:

• You have completed technical training and have relevant experience 
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics
• You can work in a 6-shift system and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge
• You speak good English.

An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:Are you seeking a new challenge where you can utilize your physical strength and precision? Our client, a renowned company in pallet production, is looking for a Robot Operator for Pallet Production.

As a Robot Operator for Pallet Production, you will be responsible for operating the production robot. Your role includes preparing the workstation: arranging planks and components on the worktable, which are then automatically assembled by the robot. The job requires physical effort, is repetitive in nature, and takes place in a noisy environment. Therefore, we are looking for someone who is up for the challenge.

Your tasks include:

• Preparing and placing planks and components on the worktable.
• Operating and monitoring the production robot.
• Ensuring a safe and efficient work environment.
• Collaborating with the team to ensure smooth production processes.

Profile DescriptionWhat are we looking for?

We are seeking an energetic and physically strong individual who meets the following requirements:

• You are physically fit and comfortable with repetitive tasks.
• You are flexible: until September, you will work in a day shift, and afterward in a two-shift system (morning and afternoon shifts).
• You can communicate in Dutch or English to collaborate effectively with the team.
• You work accurately and have attention to detail.
• You have prior experience in a production environment.

Our client, company founded in 1948, is a Belgian family business specializing in exterior joinery. Their  Group covers a range of production units. The business unit Extrusion & Finishing extrudes, anodizes and enamels aluminum profiles. Our client specializes in custom-made exterior joinery in PVC, aluminum and wood. In addition to windows and doors, many additional products are also made, such as garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:

Without solid maintenance, there is no quality! As a maintenance technician, you will be responsible for monitoring wear and tear, tracking faults, analyzing causes, proposing solutions, and optimizing production processes. Your tasks will include:

• Routine inspections and preventive maintenance.
• Risk analysis.
• Working with top-quality machines and equipment.
By collaborating with external partners, you will have the opportunity to critically assess our client’s processes and advise management and production personnel on improving their machinery park. Working in their team also means continuous development, both individually and as part of a team

Candidate Profile:

• Preferred education: Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics, industrial engineering, or equivalent experience.
• Open to all levels of experience - from junior to experienced specialists.
• Commitment and practical approach to work.
• Solid knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics.
• Curiosity and passion for technology.
• Attention to accuracy and safety in the workplace.
• Flexibility and willingness to work in shifts.
• Precision, attention to detail, and efficiency.
• Teamwork and communication skills.
• Openness to participating in the on-call system.
• Basic/communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.

Our client is a leader in the wind energy industry.

Jobomschrijving

The main responsibilities for this position are: providing maintenance, repair and support for wind turbines throughout Belgium to ensure the continuous operation of the machines.

The team leaves in the morning with a van from a service point. The service points are in: Jabbeke, Lokeren, Stabroek (Antwerp/Kapellen).

Profile:

- as wind turbine technician you have a bachelor's degree in a technical field or professional experience in a similar position

- knowledge of mechanics and/or electricity

- able to work at very high heights and in limited space

- you have a B driver's license

- you can speak English, French or Dutch

You are responsible for repairs or maintenance work on industrial vehicles, such as waste trucks, special trucks for abroad and so on.

All those vehicles are build by us.

This includes full diagnosis, maintenance, repair of claims, ...

• Experience as a mechanic or passion to work on vehicles

• You are handy and you are passionate about technology

• school leaver car mechanics is certainly possible

• Dutch or English

Are you looking for an active job in a cold (-22°C) and stable working environment?Then this might be your new challenge!You will be working for a rapidly growing logistics company that distributes frozen products.As an Order Picker, you are an indispensable link in the logistics process. You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.- You prepare orders for shipment and place pallets in the right place.- You work with an electric pallet truck.- You strictly follow the safety and quality rules.
- Vaardigheden:You have experience as an order picker or logistics employee.You are familiar with working with an electric pallet truck.You can work in a cold environment of -22°C without any problemsYou enjoy active work.You work accurately, are reliable, and think in terms of the team.- Attesten:Certificate for electric pallet truck is a plus, but not mandatory.- Opleidingsvereisten:No diploma required.- Talenkennis:Good knowledge of English

jobs.occupation: Orderpicker – Rotating Shifts – Become an essential link at SKF!
jobs.description:
Ready to put your career in motion?

SKF is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly. We are looking for motivated warehouse employees who deliver top-quality service to our customers.

Your role as an order picker:You are a crucial link in our logistics process. Thanks to your speed, precision and eye for detail, you ensure that orders are processed correctly and on time. Do you enjoy working in a dynamic environment and aren’t afraid of a challenge? Then this is the job for you!

Work schedule:

Rotating Shifts: One week 06h until 14h. The next 14h until 22h.

Full-time or part-time. 

For part-time: Minimum 3 days per week. Option: 5 half days.

?? No fear of heights?? At least a high school diploma?? You pass our tests on speed, accuracy, numeracy, language skills, spatial insight and attention to detail?? You are physically fit and enjoy active work?? Strong comprehension and speaking level of either Dutch or English

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

 

!! Please note: you do NOT qualify if you're not already living in Belgium and don't have legal permission to work in the country !!

For a dynamic international company in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative who combines customer service with commercial flair and a technical interest. You enjoy working in a role where you interact daily with customers, the sales team and internal departments, and where you can make a real impact on business growth and customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will be the main commercial and customer-oriented point of contact for your region. Working closely with the External Sales Representative, you will build strong customer relationships and help expand the customer portfolio. You will manage a combination of new and existing customers, ensuring that everything runs smoothly and professionally, from quotations to follow-up.

Your responsibilities

• Acquiring new customers and further developing existing customer relationships.
• Growing existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
• Preparing and following up on quotations and price calculations.
• Processing orders and encouraging customers to use the E-Shop.
• Maintaining daily customer contact by phone and email, with a focus on commercial growth.
• Keeping customer information up to date in ERP/CRM systems.
• Identifying customer needs and commercial opportunities.
• Acting as the first point of contact for customer questions and support.
• Working closely with the External Sales Representative on reporting and follow-up.

• You have a strong hunter mentality and a clear commercial drive to win new customers.
• You have a commercial and/or technical background.
• You have experience in B2B sales, preferably in a technical environment.
• You are fluent in both spoken and written French and English.
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage but not a requirement.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general IT tools.
• You have strong communication skills and a commercial mindset.

Account Management & Business Development

• Develops and executes account plans to achieve sales, margin and customer development objectives.
• Builds strong relationships with key decision makers and acts as the primary commercial interface.
• Drives new business, range expansion, product introductions and cross-selling across relevant aftermarket channels.
• Maintains a strong opportunity pipeline and reliable sales forecasts.
Commercial & Performance Management

• Leads commercial negotiations, including pricing, annual agreements, rebates and promotional conditions.
• Monitors sales, profitability and key commercial KPIs, implementing corrective actions where required.
• Works with Finance on receivables, credit exposure and customer financial risk.
• Provides management with clear visibility on performance, opportunities, risks and required decisions.
Market, Portfolio & Customer Activation

• Maintains strong knowledge of the Benelux automotive aftermarket, customers, competition and market trends.
• Provides market insights to support pricing, portfolio and go-to-market decisions.
• Promotes company brands and products and coordinates launches, promotions and customer activation initiatives.
Operational Excellence, Collaboration & Compliance

• Coordinates with Supply Chain, Customer Service, Marketing, Product Management and Finance to ensure effective execution and resolve customer issues.
• Provides accurate demand forecasts and supports key operational requirements.
• Ensures compliance with company policies, approval processes and competition-law principles.
• Operates with autonomy, ownership and accountability across functions and geographies.

• Knowledge of the Microsoft Office environment
• Good negotiation skills
• Good sales argumentation about the company's portfolio
• Solid skills in Dutch, French & English, understanding written correspondence & understanding technical information
• Knowledge of CRM and business intelligence tools is considered an advantage
• Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and international environment
• Good knowledge of forecasting, customer agreements and commercial performance management
• Strong key account management, negotiation and commercial planning capabilities
• Good understanding of the automotive aftermarket, its distribution channels and key commercial dynamics
